connect_grpc_server: connect to a PyBullet gRPC server on localhost with an optional custom port
set_additional_search_path: set an additional search path for PyBullet URDF and mesh asset files
load_urdf_robot: load a URDF robot model file into the PyBullet physics simulation environment
get_num_joints: get the number of joints for a loaded URDF robot body in PyBullet
get_data_path: get the PyBullet data directory path for built-in URDF and mesh assets
